scoring_justification: The model is approximate and its exact output depends on implementation details; only structural trends (ordering, saturation, threshold shift, derivative peak) are robust and independently verifiable.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold saturation value, tolerance, threshold fraction, and derivative threshold for structural checks.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: dE_E/dp for fully screened InGaN QWs is 34 meV/GPa (Fig.3). Saturation tolerance ±2 meV/GPa accounts for model approximations. Threshold fraction 0.9 is a high fraction to detect screening onset. Minimum derivative 5 meV/GPa per log decade is a low threshold to confirm a step, chosen empirically.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from paper's stated fully screened value and reasonable numerical margins.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are taken directly from the paper or set to a conservative bound that any correct implementation should exceed; they are not synthetic guesses.

outputs.description: Simulation results from the constant-field screening model; used to verify structural trends of dE_E/dp with current density and background doping.

steps.description: At the lowest current, dE_E/dp increases strictly with N_D.
At the highest current, all curves approach 34±2 meV/GPa.
The current at which dE_E/dp reaches 90% of saturation (30.6 meV/GPa) decreases strictly with increasing N_D.
Each dE_E/dp vs log(current) curve shows a distinct steplike feature (first derivative peak ≥5 meV/GPa per log decade).
